title: Session Fatigue: Why Long Agent Loops Degrade — and Why Compaction Makes It Worse
description: After a 38-commit, four-hour /dwi loop, agent output degraded in a repeatable, non-human shape — context-window dilution, self-confirmation loops, pattern-match-substitute, and recursive meta-findings. Why context compaction amplifies the worst of them, why session-end → clear → session-start is the better reset, and the value-inflection point where the audit-barrage stops finding substantive defects. Grounded in deskwork#408.
